name: Vigorbasket
description: Drop onto the target with the saber and the free arm falling together like a pair of hawks.

name: Peal Backedge
description: Turn a cut with the blade while the off arm sweeps up like a second wing.

name: Swipesolace
description: Step in two quick beats like a hawk hopping so the blade keeps its line.

name: Yelmandecree
description: Sweep the blade then return it along the same arc so two cuts land from one swing.

name: Parity Pipeback
description: Parry on the first beat and counter on the second so the response lands as a pair.

name: Swellcrown
description: Cut and hold the opponent's blade between the saber and the off hand's grip on the scabbard.

name: Symphonic Swipe
description: Chain cuts in pairs along high and low lines so each pair covers the one before.

name: Prism Falsedge
description: Dive low under a cut with the blade and the free arm covering the head together.

name: Gallant Skimmer
description: Drop with two strokes in one fall so the first opens the guard and the second pierces it.

name: Exalted Haemal Swell
description: School stroke in which a cut and its echo fall together as two hawks and press the guard into the ground.

name: Haemalgallop
description: Draw and cut in a measured arc the way one would salute and strike in court practice.

name: Deluge Yelman
description: Parry with a formal turn of the blade that sends the cut off to the side.

name: Vigoryelman
description: Take a stately forward step that keeps the shoulders square and the point on target.

name: Thunderclap Pipeback
description: Slash from the formal guard with qi evenly along the edge so the cut lands true.

name: Squall Belly
description: Rebuke a clumsy cut with a parry and a short answering cut to the forearm.

name: Steelyelman
description: Hook the curved blade round the opponent's guard and draw it aside to expose the arm.

name: Basketcrown
description: Turn on the lead foot and cut across the body so the stroke lands from the flank.

name: Orchestral Knucklebow
description: Chain salute then cut then thrust in court order so each stroke answers the last.

name: Colossal Basket
description: Hold a calm veil of qi along the blade that guards the hand and steadies the next stroke.

name: Quenched Backedge
description: Cut with the full weight of formal authority so the guard is pressed down and cannot rise.

name: Royal Steel Counterguard
description: School stroke that the court gives as final judgement on a guard sweeping through every line open to it.

name: Flourish Crown
description: Cut along one stream of the stroke while the other waits to follow behind it.

name: Spinecurve Pledge
description: Hold the blade across two lines at once as a bank holds two streams apart.

name: Evanescent Slantcut
description: Step from one bank of the line to the other without breaking the guard.

name: Vigor Slantcut
description: Slash down two streams in turn with qi flowing in each so both reach the target.

name: Sacrosanct Falsedge
description: Meet the cut where two streams join and turn it so it staggers the opponent's grip.

name: Exalted Belly
description: Cut in one stream and bind the opponent's blade in the other until it is held fast.

name: Tenet Slantcut
description: Chain cuts down both streams so each follows the other like running water.

name: Immaculate Knucklebow
description: Hold two flowing veils of qi along the blade that guard the hand and feed the cut.

name: Yelmanverdict
description: Send both streams through one wide cut that floods across the guard and those beside it.

name: Vigorbelly
description: School stroke where both streams of cut meet at one point in the guard and break through it.

name: Inferno Skimmer
description: Open with a cut that dives from high guard and settles into a low basin stance.

name: Enshrined Pipeback
description: Dive under a cut with the blade held up to turn it and settle low.

name: Vacuum Swipe
description: Thrust from the low basin stance up at the chest like a hawk rising from the water.

name: Twilit Gallop
description: Step down and in to carry the body from guard to dive in a single movement.

name: Bedrock Basket
description: Dive in and slash across the flank then settle low before the reply.

name: Revered Counterguard
description: Rebuke a cut from the settled guard and strike the exposed wrist as the blow passes.

name: Steelswipe
description: Hook the blade from below and drag the opponent's weapon down into the basin of the guard.

name: Vigorgallop
description: Cut in a dive and come to rest in a covering guard so the stroke ends safe.

name: Bellyedict
description: Chain a dive cut and a basin parry and a rising thrust as a single stoop and recovery.

name: Swell Vow
description: Hold a basin of qi around the blade that catches blows and slows the striker's follow up.

name: Slantcut Edict
description: Dive through the guard with a cut that turns the reply and settles into a safe low stance.

name: Splendid Steel Backedge
description: School stroke that joins the hawk's fall with the basin's settled guard in one finishing descent.

name: Squallswipe
description: Draw the blade up and out along a rising track with qi following the line of the arm.

name: Devout Swell
description: Turn a cut aside along an upward track and let it slide off the blade.

name: Pulsar Yelman
description: Thrust along the steel track while a pulse of qi runs on the second.

name: Paramount Gallop
description: Slash on the sky track with the qi track following half a beat behind.

name: Inviolate Spinecurve
description: Rebuke a cut with a parry on the first track and a counter on the second.

name: Vigor Swipe
description: Hook the curve of the blade and pull along the track to bind the opponent's weapon.

name: Destiny Whirl
description: Chain steel and qi strokes down both tracks so each lands as the other recovers.

name: Statute Backedge
description: Hold a pale veil of qi on the qi track that guards the hand and feeds the steel.

name: Radiance Slantcut
description: Drive steel and qi down both tracks at once so the cut pierces the guard it meets.

name: Inferno Flourish
description: School stroke in which steel and qi run on two tracks and meet in the opponent's guard.

name: Spinecurve Triumph
description: Draw and cut from the top of a leap with the body falling behind the blade.

name: Consecrated Basket
description: Hold the blade overhead and the free arm out to cover the head in flight.

name: Skyborne Falsedge
description: Spring from a deep crouch to reach the peak of a leap before the stroke.

name: Gallopbanner
description: Slash downward from the height of the leap and land on the near foot.

name: Pall Yelman
description: Parry a cut from below in mid leap with the spine and fall past it.

name: Bellytriumph
description: Hook the blade into the opponent's arm as the body falls and pull it down.

name: Squallswell
description: Cut from a height and take the landing step into the opponent's side.

name: Bellydecree
description: Chain a leap cut and a landing parry and a rising thrust in one flight and fall.

name: Counterguard Troth
description: Hold a veil of qi around the blade and arms that guards in flight and feeds the fall.

name: Steelgallop
description: Plunge from the highest point with Core qi gathered at the point to pierce guard and armor.

name: Famed Gallop
description: School stroke in which the hawk drops from its highest point and the blade falls on all before it.

name: Dauntless Whirl
description: Cut on the line the wind runs along with the draw sworn to the same direction.

name: Immaculate Belly
description: Stand in the sworn stance against the wind with the blade angled to the front.

name: Knucklebow Odyssey
description: Step with the wind and let it carry the weight from one foot to the other.

name: Haemal Whirl
description: Slash with qi on the edge in the manner a gust runs along a ridge.

name: Squall Knucklebow
description: Parry with a gust of qi that unsettles the opponent's blade as it turns.

name: Swelledict
description: Hook the curved edge round the opponent's arm and draw it into the wind.

name: Volition Gallop
description: Chain cuts in the rhythm of a rising gust so each stroke carries the one before it.

name: Venerable Spinecurve
description: Hold a veil of wind qi on the blade that blunts blows and strengthens the next cut.

name: Peerless Backedge
description: Cut with the sworn wind driving the point so it pierces the guard in its way.

name: Squallbasket
description: School stroke that closes a bout with a sworn gale of qi that presses the guard flat.

name: Bellyverdict
description: Draw and cut on the open plateau with the oath that the blade never hides.

name: Undaunted Counterguard
description: Plant the feet on the plateau and hold the blade across the line of the oath.

name: Silken Pipeback
description: Take a long even step toward the foe without breaking the sworn line.

name: Magnificent Falsedge
description: Slash across the open ground with qi held steady through the whole stroke.

name: Immaculate Yelman
description: Parry in the open and let the cut slide away on the sworn line.

name: Swelldecree
description: Hook the blade into the guard and pull the opponent's arm wide on open ground.

name: Tenetbasket
description: Chain draw and cut and thrust on the sworn line with qi held through every stroke.

name: Swell Pledge
description: Hold a veil of still qi along the blade that guards the hand and charges the cut.

name: Bedrock Pipeback
description: Cut in full view on the sworn line so the guard is pressed down and held.

name: Illustrious Thunderclap Belly
description: School stroke sworn on the plateau in which the blade goes straight through the opposing guard.

name: Quenched Gallop
description: Draw and cut along a bearing taken on the target before the blade clears the scabbard.

name: Venerable Basket
description: Parry on the bearing so the cut turns off along the same heading as the wind.

name: Twilit Swipe
description: Pace along the bearing in step with the wind so the body holds its heading.

name: Dauntless Slantcut
description: Slash along the bearing with qi carried at the edge like a gust in a channel.

name: Devout Yelman
description: Rebuke a cut with a parry on the bearing and a short answering cut along it.

name: Galloptriumph
description: Hook the blade along the bearing and pull the opponent's arm off its heading.

name: Bellycrown
description: Turn the bearing a few degrees as the cut falls so it lands off the guarded line.

name: Season Skimmer
description: Chain cuts on three bearings in turn with a gust of qi behind each.

name: Venerable Falsedge
description: Hold a veil of wind qi along the held bearing that guards and strengthens the stroke.

name: Famed Basket
description: Cut along the held bearing with a gale at the edge that rends the guard apart.

name: Triumphant Knucklebow Crown
description: School stroke that ends a bout by loosing the gale along the bearing across every foe on it.

name: Triumphant Flourish
description: Draw the blade into the open and cut with its edge plain to the foe.

name: Sacrosanct Belly
description: Parry with the edge held openly and let the cut slide off the flat.

name: Delugebelly
description: Walk the open ground with the blade low and the body turned to the foe.

name: Thunderclap Flourish
description: Slash wide and plain with qi held steady along the open edge.

name: Consecrated Pipeback
description: Rebuke a cut with a parry and an answering slash from the same open line.

name: Bedrock Spinecurve
description: Hook the open edge round the foe's guard and draw the weapon wide.

name: Seasonbasket
description: Chain open cuts one after another with nothing hidden and each stroke seen yet still landing.

name: Backedge Reliquary
description: Hold a still veil of qi on the edge that guards the hand and spoils the foe's aim.

name: Squallgallop
description: Cut in plain view with the weight of the oath so the guard cannot rise to meet it.

name: Valiant Whirl
description: School stroke that sends the open edge straight through any guard raised against it.

name: Haemalbelly
description: Open the great draw with a wide pull of the blade from the scabbard in one cut.

name: Unwavering Counterguard
description: Hold the blade half drawn across the body as a guard that can finish the draw at once.

name: Prism Slantcut
description: Thrust the point out as the draw ends and drive it at the centre.

name: Feather Skimmer
description: Step long into the draw so the whole weight of the body carries it.

name: Haemal Swipe
description: Slash from the draw with qi loosed through the blade at the moment it clears.

name: Faithful Basket
description: Parry with the half drawn blade then finish the draw as a counter cut.

name: Gallopverdict
description: Hook the edge into the guard on the draw and pull the opponent's weapon aside.

name: Whirl Crown
description: Turn on the heel while drawing so the cut arrives from the opponent's blind side.

name: Destiny Swell
description: Chain draw and cut and re-draw so the scabbard seems never to leave the hand.

name: Faithful Pipeback
description: Hold a veil of qi between blade and scabbard that guards the hand and primes the draw.

name: Magnificent Skimmer
description: Gather qi in the scabbard and loose it in one draw that rends the guard before it.

name: Royal Inferno Spinecurve
description: School stroke that draws a hundred gusts through the blade and loosed in one cut across the foe's whole front.

name: Gallant Flourish
description: Draw and cut with the oath held so the stroke does not waver in any wind.

name: Consecrated Belly
description: Hold the sworn guard steady against every gust and every blow.

name: Gallopodyssey
description: Pace into the wind with the blade steady and the oath held.

name: Quenched Yelman
description: Slash with qi held through the stroke so the edge does not drift in the wind.

name: Pall Knucklebow
description: Parry on the sworn line so the blow turns aside and the grip behind it is jarred.

name: Peerless Whirl
description: Hook the curved edge round the guard and hold the opponent's arm on the sworn line.

name: Falsedge Decree
description: Chain strokes on the sworn line with Core qi held through each so none breaks.

name: Counterguard Covenant
description: Hold a veil of Core qi along the blade that guards the hand and empowers each stroke.

name: Valiant Backedge
description: Cut along the sworn line with Core qi gathered at the point to pierce the guard in its path.

name: Vaunted Gallop
description: School stroke in which the oath carries the blade past any wind and through the guard.
